what_it_is.prose: Adani Defence handed over an indigenously manufactured Drishti 10 to the Indian Navy in January 2024. Adani's annual-report material also records delivery of the first Drishti 10 to the Indian Army. The Hermes 900 lineage is foreign-origin, so manufacturing and integration are distinguished from design origin.
